description: Restart gopls when .go files changed on disk outside the editor (after a git checkout, merge or generator run), so the LSP never serves stale diagnostics.

hooks.command: cd "${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR:-.}" && [ -f go.mod ] || exit 0; s="$HOME/.cache/agent-workflow-gopls-$(basename "$PWD").stamp" && mkdir -p "$HOME/.cache" && if [ ! -f "$s" ] || [ -n "$(find . -name '*.go' -not -path './.git/*' -newer "$s" -print -quit)" ]; then pkill -x gopls; touch "$s"; fi
